*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/divadbaroon/Documents/taxes-2025/summarize.py
+import pandas as pd
+
+RULES = [("rent", ["RENT"]), ("groceries", ["KROGER", "FOOD LION", "TRADER JOE"]), ("transport", ["BT TRANSIT", "SHELL", "AMTRAK", "UBER"]),
+         ("subscriptions", ["SPOTIFY", "STRAVA", "ICLOUD", "CHATGPT", "CLAUDE"]), ("conference/research", ["ACM", "SIGCHI", "OVERLEAF", "ZOTERO"]),
+         ("gear", ["RUNNING", "REI", "BACKCOUNTRY", "SWEETWATER"])]
+
+
+def bucket(desc):
+    d = desc.upper()
+    return next((b for b, keys in RULES if any(k in d for k in keys)), "other")
+
+
+bank = pd.read_csv("bank_2025.csv").rename(columns={"Posting Date": "date", "Description": "desc", "Amount": "amount"})
+bank["date"] = pd.to_datetime(bank.date, format="%m/%d/%Y")
+card = pd.read_csv("card_2025.csv").rename(columns={"Transaction Date": "date", "Description": "desc", "Amount": "amount"})
+card["date"] = pd.to_datetime(card.date); card["amount"] = -card.amount  # card export uses positive numbers for charges
+df = pd.concat([bank[["date", "desc", "amount"]], card[["date", "desc", "amount"]]])
+df = df[(df.amount < 0) & ~df.desc.str.contains("PAYMENT THANK YOU|AUTOPAY", case=False)]  # drop card payments (double counting)
+df["bucket"] = df.desc.map(bucket)
+print((-df.groupby("bucket").amount.sum()).round(2).sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())
+print("\nover $500:")
+print(df[df.amount < -500].sort_values("date").to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
